description: A verified flagship portrait of Péter Magyar created by Norbert Bánhalmi at Heroes' Square in Budapest on 15 March 2026 at 16:57. It is the first publicly released work in EUFÓRIA – The Anatomy of Presence. Wikimedia Commons, Wikidata, the BANHALMI professional case study, the EUFÓRIA archive, documented international editorial reuse and an owner-confirmed public Facebook post by the depicted person connect the photograph to its creator, depicted person, project and public circulation.
